purpose: Test one new training-side candidate, balanced_transductive, that adds two rounds of Sinkhorn-balanced soft pseudo-label fine-tuning on unlabeled evaluation blocks to the strongest single-view discriminative model (50ms). Rationale: experiments 53 and 54 showed inference-only structure re-ranking adds at most +1.12 and is unstable, while the evaluation blocks carry a known balanced structure (one example per class in Task3; four repeats per class in Task2) that is available without labels in the real test setting. This is transductive learning on official unlabeled inputs, not a reranker, weight search, or generative model. Development reuse is neither pristine validation nor a Kaggle result.
scope: Create files only under test/55_balanced_transductive. Do not modify src or other experiments. Experiment 48 code is read-only and supplies prepare_task2, prepare_task3, OcfPairCache, evaluate_logits, aggregate_rows, select_epoch, find_aggregate and subset_positions unchanged. Do not read experiment 49-54 outputs. No production change and no Kaggle submission.

data.row_preparation: Experiment 48 prepare_task2 and prepare_task3 unchanged on the 50ms block set.

task2.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task2', seed=42, validation_session=s) for s in session1, session2, session3, in that order

task3.split_construction: make_split(all_eight_blocks, 'task3', seed=s) for s in 20261126 and 20261127, in that order

arm.name: balanced_transductive
arm.base_epoch_source: Experiment 53 selected 50ms single-view macro epochs; reused as a fixed already-selected constant, not re-selected here.

base_training.configuration: Experiment 48 production_recipe unchanged: hidden=512, dropout mice1=0.2/mice2=0.35, label_smoothing=0.05, weight_decay=0.001, AdamW, learning_rate=3e-4, batch_size=256, apply_log=False, gradient_clip_norm=5.0, training_seed=42, bf16 autocast, TF32 disabled.
base_training.stop_rule: Train to the fixed base epoch, evaluate once, then begin transduction.

transductive_unlabeled_queries.task2: Group the held session's 10992 unlabeled single trials into 2748 rows by sample using only group_ptr/trial_sample_indices, average raw counts per sample, then apply the held session's train-fitted normalizer. No labels enter grouping or normalization.
transductive_unlabeled_queries.task3: Each of the four validation blocks contributes 2748 unlabeled single-trial rows; apply that block's train-fitted normalizer.
transductive_unlabeled_queries.label_isolation: Targets are read only after all transduction rounds are complete, for evaluation.

sinkhorn_balancing.input: row_zscore(logits) divided by fixed temperature 0.05, then row softmax
sinkhorn_balancing.column_target: 1.0 per class for every block (Task2 grouped rows and Task3 single rows both contain exactly one row per class)
sinkhorn_balancing.column_normalization: each class column sums to column_target
sinkhorn_balancing.output: soft assignment matrix P with shape rows x 2748
sinkhorn_balancing.search: none; temperature and iterations are fixed constants

fine_tuning.loss: cross_entropy(hard train logits, train targets) + 0.5 * soft_cross_entropy(val logits, Sinkhorn P)
fine_tuning.initialization: continue from the previous round's weights; never reset

inference_and_evaluation.final_prediction: argmax and unique_assignment independently on the final full 2748-class score matrix; both are reported.
inference_and_evaluation.aggregation: Experiment 48 corrected aggregate_rows: block rows -> mouse_fold -> mouse/fold/macro.

reference48.comparator: production_recipe at its own already-selected macro epoch independently in Task2 and Task3.
reference48.integrity: Before cache/CUDA access, validate both hashes, linkage, subset, selected epochs and row counts.
reference48.secondary_attribution: Also report each fold/mouse against the same 50ms base model before transduction, so the transductive increment is separable from the 50ms view increment.

advancement_gate.comparison: balanced_transductive minus experiment 48 production_recipe at production's own selected epoch, independently within each task.
advancement_gate.per_mouse: Both mouse-level assigned_final_ocf deltas must be >=0 in each task.
advancement_gate.folds: Fold-level assigned_final_ocf deltas averaged over two mice must be nonnegative for at least 2/3 Task2 folds and 2/2 Task3 folds.
advancement_gate.outcome: All per-task gates must pass for overall advance=true. Otherwise stop with no alternate temperature, iteration count, soft weight, round count or learning-rate search.

audits.per_fit: Record base metrics, per-round Sinkhorn marginal error, pseudo-label top1 agreement with the previous round, and every evaluation-block metric.
audits.isolation: Confirm by smoke test that held-out labels never enter grouping, normalization, Sinkhorn, pseudo-labels, or fine-tuning; permuting held-out labels must leave all fitted quantities and P unchanged.
audits.smoke: Synthetic checks for Sinkhorn row/column marginals, soft-target loss, label-permutation invariance, full-candidate axis, aggregation counts, and positive/negative gate cases.

outputs.overwrite_policy: Refuse --run if either output already exists.

prohibited: Task2 session4 validation or final evaluation
hidden test labels or sample-ID/target alignment
held-out labels in grouping, normalization, Sinkhorn, pseudo-labels or fine-tuning
temperature, iteration, soft-weight, round or learning-rate search
